name: Endpoint Detection & Response
description: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) — also called XDR, antivirus/anti-malware, host-based agent, CrowdStrike/Defender/SentinelOne, or endpoint security — a control that continuously monitors endpoints for malicious behavior and enables containment and remediation. The place to look for EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, host agent, anti-malware, or detecting and responding to threats on devices.
